verdict.rationale: Runpod documents custom containers pulled from any compatible registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, Amazon ECR) and lets you launch a Pod from an arbitrary image with `runpodctl pod create --image`. Templates are described as pre-configured Docker image setups, manageable via the CLI, GraphQL and REST/MCP (including registries), and a community user confirms deploying third-party templates in a few clicks. Missing for 10: detailed docs on authoring a custom template (start command, env vars, ports, private-registry credentials) and independent hands-on corroboration of running a self-built image.
